target: penicillin_offline at the current offline assay time
horizon: estimate current offline penicillin concentration from a 120-step historical online process window
input_window_definition: Each sample contains 120 historical online process steps at 12-minute resolution. t_minus_000 is the offline assay time used as the target.
online_boundary: Only continuous online process and control variables are inputs. Raman variables, penicillin_online, offline assay variables, and future labels are excluded.
process_background: IndPenSim is a fed-batch penicillin fermentation process. The selected variables describe elapsed batch time, aeration, agitation, feeds, acid/base control, thermal control, pressure, broth removal, dissolved oxygen, vessel inventory, pH, temperature, off-gas composition, metabolic rates, precursor/oil additions, and ammonia shots.

variables.name: time_h
variables.availability: online at the current and past input-window steps
variables.description: Elapsed fermentation batch time, representing process stage and biological progression.

variables.name: aeration
variables.description: Aeration rate controlling oxygen supply and gas-liquid mass transfer.

variables.name: agitator_rpm
variables.description: Agitator speed affecting mixing, oxygen transfer, and culture homogeneity.

variables.name: sugar_feed
variables.description: Sugar feed rate supplying carbon substrate for biomass growth and penicillin production.

variables.name: acid
variables.description: Acid addition used to regulate fermentation pH.

variables.name: base
variables.description: Base addition used to regulate fermentation pH.

variables.name: cooling_water
variables.description: Cooling water flow removing heat from the fermenter.

variables.name: heating_water
variables.description: Heating water flow adding heat to the fermenter.

variables.name: wfi
variables.description: Water-for-injection related flow affecting dilution and broth volume.

variables.name: air_head_pressure
variables.description: Air head pressure reflecting gas supply and vessel headspace condition.

variables.name: dumped_broth
variables.description: Dumped broth flow indicating removal of fermentation broth and inventory change.

variables.name: do2
variables.description: Dissolved oxygen measurement reflecting oxygen availability and microbial metabolic demand.

variables.name: volume
variables.description: Fermenter liquid volume affected by feeds, removals, evaporation, and sampling.

variables.name: weight
variables.description: Fermenter weight providing another online inventory measurement.

variables.name: ph
variables.description: Fermentation pH, controlled by acid/base additions and important for productivity.

variables.name: temp
variables.description: Fermenter temperature, controlled by heating and cooling and affecting biological kinetics.

variables.name: co2_out
variables.description: Carbon dioxide in outlet gas, reflecting respiration and metabolic activity.

variables.name: paa_flow
variables.description: Phenylacetic-acid precursor feed flow related to penicillin biosynthesis.

variables.name: oil_flow
variables.description: Oil or antifoam flow affecting broth condition and operational stability.

variables.name: our
variables.description: Oxygen uptake rate, reflecting microbial respiration and metabolic intensity.

variables.name: o2_out
variables.description: Oxygen concentration in outlet gas, coupled with aeration and oxygen uptake.

variables.name: cer
variables.description: Carbon dioxide evolution rate, reflecting respiration and production-related metabolism.

variables.name: ammonia_shots
variables.description: Ammonia shot additions that may affect nitrogen availability, pH control, and broth chemistry.
